<!-- pr-reviewer: 86e566b1ede0579ec5b3d3ead4ab4752ff3e6448 -->
Read, not built: text only. Two files: one new row in `.claude/skills/camcraft-mcp/SKILL.md` (line 87, after `set_stock`) and `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION` 18 to 19 (LF ending; main reads 18).

**Ready for the maintainer to merge.** Every fact in the row matches the code on origin/main:
- Tool and parameter: `set_raw_stock_only` is registered in `crates/app/src/mcp/setup_tools.rs:28`; its schema (`s_raw_stock_only`, line 255) has a single required boolean `on`. There is no optional `setup` parameter, and the row does not claim one. The command acts on the active setup's stock.
- "One undo step": `set_raw_stock_only` calls `env.history.execute` once with one `SetStockSourceOnly` (`setup_tools.rs:259-263`).
- "Refused by name when the active stock is not made from a model": `stock_source_only.rs:52-54` ("'<stock>' is not made from a model - ..."). Correct.
- Mark holds only while the source is unchanged, else ignored and named: `stock_source.rs` `mark_of` (Mark::Void) and `void_text`, which names the source model.
- Operation that machines the model puts it back: `names()` in `stock_source.rs` covers the source and boundary picks.
- Nothing left to judge is refused by name: `nothing_judged` (`stock_source.rs:191`), called from `posting_sim.rs:66`.

Wording notes (not blocking):
1. "its geometry is unchanged" could mislead an agent that moves the model. The fingerprint (`stock_print::print_of`) covers placement (position and rotation) as well as geometry, so moving the model also voids the mark. Suggest "its geometry and placement are unchanged" or "neither its geometry nor its placement changed".
2. The row lists one refusal. `SetStockSourceOnly::new` also refuses with "no stock '<name>' - set the stock first" (`stock_source_only.rs:34`) and when the source model is missing or has no geometry (`stock_source_only.rs:46-50`). Both are real and named, so an agent would see them, but the row could say "Refused by name when the active stock is missing or is not made from a model, or its source has no geometry".
3. PROCESS_VERSION 19 is also claimed by PR #965. Whichever merges second takes 20, per AGENTS.md.

Body carries `Fixes #1106` and `Changelog: none`. No other file changed.
Back to draft: merging main (PR #965 took PROCESS_VERSION 19, so this takes 20), plus two wording notes from the review (placement in the mark's validity; the two refusals the row omitted).

Delta read by the main session after the clean fact check of 86e566b1: the merge of main, `PROCESS_VERSION` 20, and the reviewer's two wording notes applied to the one row (placement voids the mark; the two refusals named). Text only. Merging.
